curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What does the drone’s recording threaten to expose after Stéphane and his colleagues are overrun during an arrest?
curatedMovie.description: After joining an Anti-Crime Squad in the Paris suburb of Montfermeil, officer Stéphane navigates soaring neighborhood frictions until a chaotic arrest is caught on camera by a local drone.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense, socially charged, and heavy. A steady, pressure-cooker thriller best experienced with undivided focus.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ladj Ly delivers a gripping, grounded crime drama where street-level pressures and institutional fractures collide with volatile urgency.
